• Unordered, records/s at workMicros 0 / 100 / 1000: KPipe 914k / 665k / 615k, Atleon 696k / 577k / 571k, raw 1.04M / 748k / 748k.
• KPipe ÷ Atleon: 1.31x / 1.15x / 1.08x unordered, 1.01x / 1.13x / 0.95x per key. KPipe ÷ raw: 0.88x / 0.89x / 0.82x.
• gc.count and gc.time are totals for the measurement window, so faster arms run more invocations and collect more.
Per-partition arms and the single-threaded baseline are omitted: different guarantee. Full table: benchmarks/results/2026-10-21/2026-10-21-ci-parallel.md
